tasks.title: Bootstrap repository, locked toolchain, and workspace boundaries
acceptance: Toolchain versions are committed
Student, admin, worker, and shared package boundaries exist
Local setup is reproducible from documented commands
stopConditions: Chosen framework or package manager contradicts an accepted ADR

tasks.title: Create CI, contract checks, and deterministic test harness
acceptance: CI runs formatting, lint, type, unit, contract, and migration checks
Failures block merge
Synthetic fixture runner is deterministic

tasks.title: Establish configuration, secret, feature-flag, and audit conventions
acceptance: Secrets never enter source or client bundles
Production-sensitive capabilities default off
Configuration validation fails closed
stopConditions: A production credential is proposed for local fixtures

tasks.title: Implement baseline observability and evidence capture
acceptance: Correlation IDs cross API, worker, and provider boundaries
Redaction rules cover PII and secrets
Release evidence has an immutable location

tasks.title: Build app identity, session, and deterministic login mapping
acceptance: One app identity can map to known external identities
Session revocation is enforceable
Login mapping is deterministic and audited
stopConditions: Live WordPress identity evidence required by OD-02 is unavailable

tasks.title: Implement versioned WordPress identity bridge adapter
acceptance: Bridge calls are authenticated, versioned, retried, and idempotent
External identifiers are preserved
Provider outage degrades safely

tasks.title: Create identity conflict queue and operator resolution workflow
acceptance: Ambiguous mappings never auto-merge
Operator actions are reversible and audited
Affected user access is not silently discarded

tasks.title: Enforce RBAC, object scope, and privileged-action audit
acceptance: Student, tutor, moderator, admin, and super-admin permissions are explicit
Object-level authorization is server-enforced
Privileged mutations include actor, reason, and correlation ID

tasks.title: Model product, offer, SKU, bundle, and validity policy
acceptance: Bundles reference capabilities without duplicating learning content
Offer windows and validity policies are explicit
SKU-to-capability mapping is versioned

tasks.title: Ingest immutable raw commerce events and normalize provider payloads
acceptance: Raw payload, signature outcome, and received time are retained
Normalized event has stable schema and provider IDs
Invalid events are quarantined
stopConditions: OD-01 signed Sejoli event sample is unavailable for production claim

tasks.title: Process purchase lifecycle into access grants with outbox delivery
acceptance: Paid events create grants exactly once
Retries and replays are idempotent
Outbox prevents partial commerce/access commits

tasks.title: Handle refund, cancellation, expiry, and source-isolated revocation
acceptance: A source can revoke only grants it created
Overlapping valid access survives another source refund
Every removal has a reason and audit trail

tasks.title: Implement checkout intent and safe return-to-app recovery
acceptance: Checkout intent is correlated without trusting query-string payment state
Return page shows pending until server confirmation
Retry never creates duplicate purchase effects

tasks.title: Build commerce reconciliation and exception operations
acceptance: Orders, events, grants, and effective access can be reconciled
Exceptions have owner and resolution state
Repair is idempotent and audited
stopConditions: Finance-approved order/refund reconciliation evidence is unavailable for production sign-off

tasks.title: Implement immutable access grants and versioned entitlement policies
acceptance: Grant source, subject, resource, interval, and policy version are immutable
Manual, scholarship, purchase, and migration sources coexist
Policy publication is versioned

tasks.title: Build effective-access resolver, cache, and explanation trace
acceptance: Resolver unions active grants and enforces explicit denies only where contracted
Response explains decisive sources
Cache invalidation follows grant mutations

tasks.title: Create deterministic entitlement rebuild and drift detection
acceptance: Effective access can be rebuilt from source records
Drift is reported before repair
Rebuild is repeatable without widening access

tasks.title: Add manual grant, extension, and revocation with reasoned approval
acceptance: Manual changes require reason and authorized actor
High-risk changes support peer approval
Changes never rewrite original purchase grants

tasks.title: Build program-centric home, active context, and cross-product deduplication
acceptance: Home prioritizes the active program and next action
Multiple products do not duplicate shared content
Empty, expired, and multi-program states match UX contracts

tasks.title: Implement versioned curriculum, tracks, modules, and release rules
acceptance: Curriculum publication creates an immutable version
Tracks and modules support ordered and scheduled release
Existing learners retain pinned behavior where specified

tasks.title: Create program onboarding and student preference capture
acceptance: Onboarding is resumable
Required TKA choices are validated
Preferences do not grant unauthorized content

tasks.title: Build reusable learning resources, assets, recordings, and secure delivery
acceptance: One resource can be attached to multiple programs without content copying
Assets use authorized time-bound delivery
Recordings and documents honor access expiry

tasks.title: Implement progress events, rollups, and explainable completion
acceptance: Progress derives from immutable learning events
Rollups are rebuildable
Completion rules are visible and versioned

tasks.title: Implement schedule, live class, reminder, recording, and attendance lifecycle
acceptance: Schedule uses canonical UTC with user-local rendering
Join links are access-controlled
Recordings and attendance reconcile to the session

tasks.title: Model versioned questions, stimuli, options, assets, and answer secrets
acceptance: Published question versions are immutable
Stimuli and images are reusable
Correct answers and weights never reach active-attempt clients

tasks.title: Build idempotent XLSX and ZIP import with validation and rollback
acceptance: Simple and advanced templates are versioned
Archive paths and media types are safely validated
Re-running an import cannot silently duplicate questions

tasks.title: Create preview, moderation, approval, and revision workflow
acceptance: Mobile and desktop preview match delivery rendering
Creator cannot approve own high-risk publication
Rejected revisions preserve history

tasks.title: Implement exam family, versioned blueprint, form, and publication validation
acceptance: One core engine supports multiple versioned blueprint families
Form snapshots pin question versions
Publication validators fail closed on inconsistent policy
stopConditions: A real regulatory threshold is requested without OD-04 evidence

tasks.title: Build tryout batch, sales, attempt, release, and leaderboard windows
acceptance: All windows are independent and timezone-safe
Batch state is server-derived
Changing offer windows cannot change attempt history

tasks.title: Create authorized attempt start, immutable snapshot, and resumable state
acceptance: Start checks effective access and batch window
Snapshot pins all scoring-relevant versions
Resume restores authoritative server state

tasks.title: Implement server-authoritative lease, timer, autosave, and offline recovery
acceptance: Server deadline is authoritative
Answer writes are idempotent and monotonic
Lease conflicts and offline queues resolve without silent answer loss

tasks.title: Implement submit, expiry finalization, and attempt audit telemetry
acceptance: Manual and automatic submit are idempotent
Expiry closes from server time
Audit telemetry supports incident reconstruction without exposing answer secrets

tasks.title: Add explicit accessibility accommodation to attempt snapshots
acceptance: Accommodation is authorized before attempt start
Time adjustment is pinned in snapshot
Leaderboard policy handles accommodated attempts explicitly

tasks.title: Build deterministic versioned scorer and component calculation
acceptance: Same snapshot and answers always produce same score
Component, total, threshold, and rank inputs are separately recorded
Synthetic policies are visibly non-production
stopConditions: SKD production activation requested before OD-04 is approved

tasks.title: Create result release, immutable history, and correction workflow
acceptance: Release follows batch policy
Correction appends a new result version
Old and new values, reason, approver, and ranking version remain traceable

tasks.title: Implement privacy-safe versioned leaderboard
acceptance: Leaderboard identity display follows consent and pseudonym rules
Ranking input population is explicit
Corrections create a new ranking version

tasks.title: Build admin builders with audit history and protected domain workflows
acceptance: Product, program, curriculum, exam, and batch operations use domain commands
No direct production row-edit interface exists
Every publication is auditable

tasks.title: Create live-operations dashboard and bounded recovery actions
acceptance: Operators can see failing webhooks, access mismatches, imports, attempts, and scoring jobs
Recovery actions are idempotent and scoped
Emergency actions require reason

tasks.title: Enforce maker-checker approval for high-risk operations
acceptance: Question, blueprint, scoring, result correction, and large access changes can require distinct approver
Self-approval is rejected
Approval evidence is retained

tasks.title: Implement notification preferences, transactional delivery, and suppression
acceptance: Transactional and marketing consent are separate
Reminders are deduplicated and timezone-safe
Provider failures retry without message storms

tasks.title: Implement privacy-bounded analytics events and product funnels
acceptance: Event names and properties are versioned
Sensitive answers and unnecessary PII are excluded
Core acquisition, activation, learning, and exam funnels are queryable

tasks.title: Profile legacy users, orders, products, and access mappings
acceptance: Source counts, nulls, duplicates, and unmapped codes are quantified
Mapping decisions have owners
No real PII enters development fixtures
stopConditions: Sanitized legacy source snapshot and 05A promise evidence are unavailable

tasks.title: Build repeatable migration ETL and source-to-target reconciliation
acceptance: ETL is restartable and records lineage
Counts and money/access invariants reconcile
Exceptions are isolated for manual review

tasks.title: Rehearse cutover, rollback, and post-cutover reconciliation
acceptance: Rehearsal measures duration and error volume
Rollback point and authority are explicit
Post-cutover reconciliation completes inside the agreed window
stopConditions: No approved rollback authority or recovery point exists

tasks.title: Complete security, privacy, abuse, and dependency verification
acceptance: Critical threat scenarios are tested
Dependency and secret scans are clean
Retention and deletion operations are evidenced
stopConditions: Any open critical security finding exists

tasks.title: Complete mobile, browser, and WCAG 2.2 accessibility verification
acceptance: Critical student and admin flows pass supported devices
Keyboard, focus, contrast, labels, and zoom checks pass
Exam images remain legible on target mobile screens

tasks.title: Verify load, soak, queue recovery, and SLO evidence
acceptance: Peak batch and webhook scenarios meet agreed SLOs
Soak test shows no unbounded resource growth
Backlog recovery time is measured
stopConditions: OD-08 production capacity envelope is not approved

tasks.title: Prove backup, restore, and disaster-recovery procedures
acceptance: Database and object restore are performed in an isolated environment
RPO and RTO evidence is recorded
Access and result history survive restoration
stopConditions: Restore has never been executed successfully

tasks.title: Execute UAT, progressive rollout, launch, and hypercare
acceptance: Business UAT is signed
Gates A through D are GO with evidence
Progressive rollout and rollback checkpoints are observed
Hypercare ownership and escalation remain staffed
stopConditions: Any required release gate is not GO
Any hard external gate remains unresolved
